name: exp_3rvi
summary: This EA trades based on the 3-period Relative Vigor Index (RVI) indicator, generating buy and sell signals when the RVI main line crosses its signal line. It opens positions in the direction of the crossover and manages trades with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于3周期相对活力指数(RVI)指标进行交易，当RVI主线与其信号线交叉时产生买卖信号。它在交叉方向开仓，并使用可配置的止损和止盈水平管理交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于相对活力指数(RVI)指标的交叉信号。RVI指标衡量价格收于高点附近的力度，主线与信号线的交叉被视为动量转变的标志。入场条件为RVI主线从下方穿越信号线时做多，从上方穿越信号线时做空。出场条件依赖预设的固定止损和止盈水平，没有追踪止损或动态出场机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动性进行动态调整。资金管理方面仅依赖止损来控制单笔风险，缺乏整体仓位控制和回撤保护机制。策略逻辑相对简单，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on crossover signals from the Relative Vigor Index (RVI) indicator. The RVI measures the vigor of price closing near its highs, and crossovers between the main line and signal line are interpreted as momentum shifts. Entry conditions trigger a buy when the RVI main line crosses above its signal line, and a sell when it crosses below. Exit conditions rely on preset fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanism. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management depends solely on stop loss to control per-trade risk, lacking overall position control and drawdown protection. The strategy logic is relatively simple and works best in trending markets, but is prone to frequent false signals in choppy or ranging conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 策略逻辑简洁清晰，易于理解和维护
RVI指标在趋势市场中能较好捕捉动量转换
使用魔术编号管理订单，避免与其他EA冲突
止损止盈参数可配置，提供基本风险控制
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and maintain
RVI indicator captures momentum shifts effectively in trending markets
Uses magic number for order management, avoiding conflicts with other EAs
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 固定手数无法根据市场波动或账户规模动态调整
缺乏追踪止损机制，可能无法充分捕获趋势利润
没有震荡市过滤机制，在盘整行情中容易频繁亏损
缺少新K线检查，可能同一根K线内重复开仓
没有资金管理和回撤保护机制
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust based on market volatility or account size
Lacks trailing stop mechanism, potentially failing to capture full trend profit
No ranging market filter, prone to frequent losses in choppy conditions
Missing new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions within the same bar
No money management or drawdown protection mechanism
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损和仓位管理，根据市场波动自动调整风险参数
添加趋势过滤器（如均线方向），避免在震荡市中交易
增加新K线检查机制和点差过滤，提高入场质量
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and position sizing to automatically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility
Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid trading in ranging markets
Implement new bar check mechanism and spread filter to improve entry quality

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查，可能在同一K线内多次开仓导致过度交易
固定手数不考虑账户余额变化，大亏损后风险比例会升高
无回撤保护和最大持仓限制
risk_points_en: Missing new bar check, potentially opening multiple positions within the same bar leading to overtrading
Fixed lot size does not account for account balance changes, risk ratio increases after large losses
No drawdown protection or maximum position limit
